Ajay (Sales): Hey team — urgent approval request for PeregrinePilot pilot deal. Customer wants a 6-month pilot, committed spend $120k. Asking for a one-off 25% onboarding discount and Net45 payment terms. Need sign-off this week to close. Quote: https://redwood.app/quotes/QL-4729 cc @Maya (Finance) @Reina (RevOps)
Maya (Finance): Quick Qs — what's the baseline list price for the 6mo? Margin impact? Is this pre-paid or invoiced month-to-month? Also need Legal to sign off on Net45.
Ajay (Sales): List price for the pilot was $160k so 25% brings it to $120k. Customer will be invoiced up front for the pilot (they requested consolidated invoice). Usage assumptions: 10 seats, avg 4M tokens/month. Expected conversion to Dedicated in Q4 if pilot metrics met.
Reina (RevOps): FYI I can approve up to 20% discount without escalations. 25% requires Finance head approval + a recorded exception in SFDC. Can we do 20% + $15k onboarding credit instead? Also need a payment term justification in the quote.
Ajay (Sales): Customer is firm on Net45 because of their procurement cycle. Onboarding credit is ok but they prefer discount on the first invoice. If 20%+credit is easier we can present that.
Maya (Finance): Rough impact calc:
```
List = $160,000
Requested = 25% off -> $120,000
Gross impact ~ $40k less recognized vs list over 6mo, estimated GM reduction ~ $12k (taking COGS into account)
```
We need: Legal ok on Net45, RevOps to log exception, and a clawback clause if no conversion within 9 months.
Steph (Head of Finance): I can approve a one-off 25% onboarding discount and Net45 on the condition that Legal signs payment terms and we add a 12-month clawback: if they don't convert to a revenue-generating contract within 12 months we reserve the right to invoice the difference. Also require RevOps to tag the opportunity as "pilot-carveout" and set renewal reminders.
Reina (RevOps): Copy — I'll log the exception in SFDC (reason: strategic pilot + potential Dedicated conversion) and create the renewal task. I'll also update the quote to show either (A) 25% onboarding discount, Net45, or (B) 20% + $15k onboarding credit — which option would Sales like to present?
Ajay (Sales): We will present option A (25% + Net45) per customer ask. Will attach customer PO and send to Legal now. Thanks @Steph and @Reina.
deals-bot: Contract uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.app/contr/CTR-9881 and quote revised.
Maya (Finance): I'll prepare the internal memo for the accounting treatment and send the revenue deferral schedule once Legal confirms. Please make sure the final signed contract includes the clawback language: `if no conversion within 12 months, customer will be invoiced for the difference between list and pilot price` — legal to confirm exact wording. :thumbsup:
Ajay (Sales): Great — looping in Legal and customer. Will post final signed timestamp here. Thanks all :rocket:
